Cookie notice

What this site stores—and what it does not.

Updated September 10, 2026

Private preview · Draft for business review. Legal business details and the contact address must be confirmed before public launch.

Arclume’s website code

This version does not set first-party cookies, use localStorage or sessionStorage, or include analytics and advertising trackers. The project brief is generated in memory in your browser. A downloaded brief is a file on your device, not a cookie.

Hosting and private access

The hosting or sign-in platform may use cookies or similar mechanisms for authentication, security and delivery of this private site. This notice does not claim those platform cookies are absent. Platform settings and notices govern their operation.

Social profiles and media

There are no embedded social feeds, video players or tracking widgets in this version. Active social links, once provided, will open the relevant external platform; its cookie notice will apply there. Pending profiles do not connect to a social platform.

Your choices

You can inspect or remove cookies in your browser’s site settings. Blocking cookies required by the hosting platform may affect access to a private page. There is no advertising-cookie preference to toggle in Arclume’s current page code.

Future changes

If analytics, advertising pixels, embedded media or new form services are added, the site’s notices and any required consent controls must be updated before those tools are activated.

Questions

The studio’s contact address is being finalized for this private preview. A verified address for privacy requests and other inquiries will be published before the site opens to the public.
